message.reasoning:
Boardwalk would complete my dark blue monopoly, and with $1016 I could afford it while still having cash left for houses. P1's three hotels on the light blues are dangerous, so I need my own monopoly to compete—paying around $500 for Boardwalk leaves roughly $516, enough to start building a house or two on Park Place and Boardwalk.

P4 has $701 and might overpay just to block me, so I'm weighing how high to go. I'll push my bid up toward 450-600, figuring that if p4 pays 650 they'd be left with only $51 and effectively crippled, so starting with a bid of 450 seems like the right move.
